title: Ocular Trauma
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: These are eye injuries that result from blunt or sharp objects or from chemical substances injuring the eye. The management of these injuries is guided by history from the patient and ocular findings by the clinicians. Classes of ocular trauma are as follows: -
